name: SOXL/TQQQ Rotation with cash
description: Daily SOXL/TQQQ relative-momentum rotation scanner with SMA150 cash regime and optional Alpaca paper execution.

strategy.base_rotation: Monthly SOXL/TQQQ relative momentum using 63-day return minus 0.5 * annualized volatility, skip the most recent 10 trading days, prefer chosen/alternate above SMA50, 5% hysteresis.
strategy.cash_filter: Risk-off only when the selected ETF and QQQ are both below SMA150; re-enter when either selected ETF or QQQ is above SMA150 + 1%.
strategy.positioning: Target SOXL, TQQQ, or CASH. No DCA in the balanced cash version.
